name: template generator
description: Looks across your local Claude, Cline and Grok Bot session history for setup work you keep repeating, then presents a grid of bot templates you can build from and pass on. Assumes you already have a body of past sessions on the machine for it to draw patterns from.

official.title: template generator by Jarett
official.description: Scan local Claude, Cline, and Grok Bot sessions for common setup tasks, then offer a matrix of grok bot templates you can generate and share.
